text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered: autoscaler provisioning failing -> inference-queues building up. Alert: pd://PAGER/INC-84721. Symptoms: steady increase in queue depth for /v1/generate, elevated 429s and 503s from gateway, latency spike.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert fired (INC-84721). Paging rotation: maya, ron, jen_ops.

maya: acked. I'm on it, joining. Immediately checking autoscaler logs and queue metrics.

ron: pulling logs now. earliest sign ~10:07 UTC, spike in pending pods for serve-group inference-worker-ephemeral. autoscaler keeps failing to create nodes.

ron: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:08:11Z scale-controller error: ProvisionDenied: CloudQuotaExceeded(zone-us-west1-b): requested 8 vCPU, available 0
2026-03-15T10:08:11Z scale-controller debug: attempted provisioning group inference-worker-spot-xx: failed
2026-03-15T10:08:12Z queue-monitor warn: queue_depth=/v1/generate size=420 increase_rate=+230/s
```

jen_ops: I can see corresponding quota errors in the cloud console (projects/rdw-prod -> quotas). It shows CPU quota exhausted in us-west1-b on our account. There's a pending quota request from last week still in review.

maya: ok, immediate mitigation plan: 1) manual scale up of fallback nodegroup in us-west1-a (different zone) 2) fail traffic over low-latency subset /dedicated-pool for paying customers 3) open provider ticket to bump quota and watch autoscaler.

maya: running manual nodes add (hand command):
```
# infra-runbook snippet
# create nodepool fallback: 5 nodes, standard-2, taint=reserve:inference
cloudctl nodepools create --project rdw-prod --region us-west1 --zone us-west1-a --name fallback-small --machine-type n1-standard-2 --count 5 --tags=inference-fallback
```

deploy-bot: nodepool fallback-small creation started -> op-45321. ETA ~3m.

ron: while that spins up, I'm going to scale the replica counts for the queue consumers so they pick up pending work from local pods where possible: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-consumer --replicas=20`

jen_ops: nodepool op-45321 is done, nodes reporting Ready. I'm updating autoscaler config to include fallback-small as a valid pool.

maya: routing rule update: shifting 20% of /v1/generate traffic to dedicated-pool (low-latency SLA customers excluded) to reduce pressure. Doing now in console.

support_amy: what's the customer impact so we can draft comms? I can prod the CS rotation and prepare status page.

maya: early numbers: between 10:07-10:22 UTC ~ 14 unique customers saw increased tail latency, 4 customers experienced client-side timeouts (503). A small subset of high-throughput tenants saw elevated 429s due to queue saturation. No data loss.

support_amy: ok, crafting message: "We are experiencing degraded inference throughput due to capacity provisioning issues; mitigation in progress. Some requests may time out or receive transient 429s."

ron: autoscaler logs now show provisioning attempts to us-west1-a succeeded after adding nodepool. scale-controller logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:16:32Z scale-controller info: ProvisionSucceeded(group=inference-worker-fallback, nodes_added=5)
2026-03-15T10:16:45Z queue-monitor info: queue_depth=/v1/generate size=198 decrease_rate=-80/s
```

maya: traffic settling. SLA customers routed to dedicated-pool. Queue depth trending down. Still watching error rates.

jen_ops: opened support ticket with cloud provider (TKT-9921) referencing quota request + emergency bump. Provider responded: temporary quota increase granted for 24h; they will fast-track permanent bump.

sre_lead: taking incident lead. Good work. Next steps: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) ensure autoscaler config includes fallback pools and tolerations, 3) add circuit-breaker: when queue_depth > 500 -> route to fallback model (quantized) to avoid 503s, 4) follow up with capacity planning to prevent recurring quota depletion.

maya: adding runbook note and incident timeline. tagging as P1 -> postmortem required. Assigning owners: ron (logs/debug), jen_ops (cloud ticket & quota), support_amy (customer comms).

support_amy: posted status on status.redwood.ai and notified top 20 customers by email template. Initial impact note posted at 10:28 UTC.

deploy-bot: verified extra nodes are cordoned and labeled for inference workloads.

pagerduty-bot: INC-84721 acknowledged by maya at 10:12 UTC, incident escalated to sre_lead.

maya: marking as mitigated. queue_depth < 50 and error rate normalized. Beginning incident wrap-up and timeline capture.

sre_lead: incident closed for active mitigation at 10:28 UTC. We'll keep monitoring and follow up with postmortem and action items (quota alerts, autoscaler fallback policy change, playbook update).

pagerduty-bot: INC-84721 status -> resolved. Resolution note: temporary nodepool created and traffic partially routed; cloud provider granted temporary quota bump. Permanent fix pending postmortem and capacity adjustments.

maya: thumbs up :thumbsup: filing the postmortem now.
